E-1.what: the pin's compiled embedded SQL (SELECT INTO, cursor, INSERT, INSERT ... SELECT WHERE NOT EXISTS, DELETE) has the dynamic statement's permitted outcomes for E-NEST, E-PARTIAL, E-SQL-END, E-DRV, E-AUTOCOMMIT, E-VIS, E-ROWLOCK, E-UNIQUE, E-STOP, X-STMT, X-NULL; -104, -108

S-1.what: the pin's compiled SQL functions Txn_Begin / Txn_End / Txn_Undo act on the calling connection's process and transaction

X2-TOP.what: TOP n, LIMIT n [OFFSET m] over ORDER BY (SQLUPPER default, DESC, %EXACT) and unordered

X2-BATCH.what: DB-API executemany: a refused row of several skipped silently; one row raises

X2-IOU.what: INSERT OR UPDATE: inserts / updates; waits for a held row; -109 if it is gone

X2-MERGE.what: MERGE (copy, onto existing, rolled back) and ZKILL (value only, rolled back)
